hints.title: Modular Prefix Expansion
hints.text: The numeric value of a prefix can grow up to 10^5 digits long, so track its modulo m instead of the full number.

hints.title: Transition Formula
hints.text: For each incoming digit d, update the remainder as rem = (rem * 10 + d) % m.

hints.title: Divisibility Bit Evaluation
hints.text: If rem equals 0, set the output indicator at index i to 1; otherwise, set it to 0.

hints.title: Streaming Modular Divisibility Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass computing rolling remainders.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting large prefix substrings into arbitrary-precision integers takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond result list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses modular arithmetic to prevent big integer overhead.
